nodes.label: Canvas.js auto-path canvas contract (#autoPathContainer)
nodes.rationale: The container needs a definite non-zero size and must be displayed when new Canvas() runs; there is no ResizeObserver.

nodes.label: CSRF contract (meta tag, inline fetch wrapper, hidden csrf_token inputs)
nodes.norm_label: csrf contract (meta tag, inline fetch wrapper, hidden csrf_token inputs)
nodes.rationale: Tests regex-scrape the meta and slice the IIFE by its exact text, so attribute order, the 'Send the CSRF token' comment and '(function () {' ... '})();' must stay verbatim in base.html.

nodes.label: .animate-fade-in-up flash toast hook (and .container hazard)
nodes.rationale: Auto-dismiss removes child divs of any .animate-fade-in-up after 5 s; adding a .container class makes the silent form-canvas showStatus toasts appear.

nodes.label: [hidden] attribute vs display-class cascade bug
nodes.rationale: Preflight [hidden] is emitted before .btn and display utilities at equal specificity, so #loadMoreMatches never hides; add [hidden]{display:none !important} in @layer base.

nodes.label: 'hidden' class show/hide mechanism
nodes.rationale: Responsive display utilities (sm:flex, md:grid) beat .hidden, so never put them on toggled panels, tabs or modals.

nodes.label: Class-based dark mode on <html> (localStorage.theme)
nodes.rationale: compare.js observes html.dark to redraw the radar chart and auton.css / mock page use .dark rules, so dark must stay a class on documentElement.

nodes.label: Global functions for inline onclick handlers
nodes.norm_label: global functions for inline onclick handlers

nodes.label: Kit vs Castle class conflicts (.grid, .card, .btn, .link, .badge, main > section)
nodes.norm_label: kit vs castle class conflicts (.grid, .card, .btn, .link, .badge, main > section)
nodes.rationale: Fix conflicts by where files are loaded, never by editing kit files (kit-edited is an unwaivable gate FAIL).

nodes.label: Kit fit: taste-skill 2.5.1
nodes.rationale: Port the kit's tokens and rules into Tailwind on app pages and load kit files only on the landing page, because system.css/motion.css break Tailwind layouts and Castle components.

nodes.label: landing_base.html landing page plan
nodes.rationale: index.html picks its layout by auth state, so anonymous visitors get the kit landing shell while logged-in users keep the app shell.

nodes.label: <main> px-4 gutter coupling (-mx-4 edge-bleed navs and save bars)
nodes.norm_label: <main> px-4 gutter coupling (-mx-4 edge-bleed navs and save bars)
nodes.rationale: If the 16px phone gutter changes, the -mx-4 negative margins on save bars and scrolling tool navs must change with it.

nodes.label: Match list partial/JSON pagination contract
nodes.rationale: GET /scouting?partial=1 returns {html,total,has_more,next_page}; list.js keeps only #teamDataContainer > .event-section > tbody > tr.team-row.

nodes.label: .mobile-menu-button / .mobile-menu shell hooks
nodes.rationale: querySelector with no null check: if either is missing, the inline script throws and the theme toggle and user dropdown never bind.

nodes.label: #nav-offline-indicator / #mobile-offline-indicator (body.offline)
nodes.rationale: base.js finds them by id; today the indicator is invisible on phones, so add a phone-visible one but keep the ids.

nodes.label: Richardson Brand Accelerator wordmark font
nodes.rationale: The file name has spaces, so the SW url.includes match fails on the percent-encoded request; rename to a woff2 without spaces.

nodes.label: Scouting form field-name and value server contract
nodes.norm_label: scouting form field-name and value server contract
nodes.rationale: Field names and exact values (e.g. 'true' strings, robot_disabled None/Partially/Full, TBA match labels) are what the server parses.

nodes.label: Script-loading contract (classic scripts, order, currentScript)
nodes.rationale: base.js and settings.js read document.currentScript.dataset, so they stay classic scripts; the CSRF wrapper runs first and notifications.js loads before team/manage.js.

nodes.label: Service worker STATIC_ASSETS precache and cache-name bump
nodes.norm_label: service worker static_assets precache and cache-name bump
nodes.rationale: Static assets are cache-first with no version query: bump cache names v14->v15 (CACHE_VERSION 15->16) after rebuilding CSS, or phones keep the old tailwind.css.

nodes.label: Sticky full-width save bar (z-index stack, safe-area)
nodes.norm_label: sticky full-width save bar (z-index stack, safe-area)

nodes.label: Pit entries pre-decision
nodes.rationale: Off-server pit creation is a non-goal, so outside venue mode a pit with an existing _id is already_have and any other is rejected; avoids an untested create path with no caller.

nodes.label: PROTECTED import fields
nodes.rationale: Fields like scouter_team, excluded, event_key, match_key, uploaded_by, origin, fuel_pending are stripped from imported entries so spoofed values are never stored; keys are recomputed.

nodes.label: Lie-fi risk
nodes.rationale: The POST reached the server but the response was lost, so the entry is both saved and queued; client_id makes the later sync report already_have.

nodes.label: access_match scope
nodes.rationale: Castle is multi-team and each team sees only its own records; records from two teams must never block each other.

nodes.label: Already-have rule
nodes.rationale: An entry whose _id or client_id already exists is already_have and nothing is written; this makes every transfer path idempotent. Unindexed lookup marked shortcut since team_data is small.

nodes.label: Anti-goal: spoofing
nodes.rationale: Any team member creating entries as another team's scout or setting fields the add form can't; the old qrf branch import accepted raw documents and had this problem.

nodes.label: castle-entries format
nodes.rationale: One JSON envelope serves phone sync, QR and files, so there is a single import path to secure and test.

nodes.label: client_id
nodes.rationale: Stored on add-form records too (the posted _draft_id), so a later sync of the same entry is recognised as already_have.

nodes.label: GET /scouting/export
nodes.rationale: Exports current-season matches the user can see, team pits and public fields of every team member (so a rookie's first entries are accepted on the laptop); never password hashes or emails.

nodes.label: Incoming _id reuse rule
nodes.rationale: Amended after security review: on the main server an incoming _id/client_id only counts as already_have within the uploader's access_match scope and is never reused for inserts, so uploaders cannot probe other teams' record ids.

nodes.label: No double counting
nodes.rationale: Every path that moves entries (phone sync, QR, both file imports) must be safe to repeat; uploading the same entry twice never creates two records.

nodes.label: Outbox sync
nodes.rationale: POSTs the outbox to /scouting/import on load, on online and every 60 s; removes saved/already_have/duplicate, keeps rejected with reason, keeps everything on session expiry.

nodes.label: POST /scouting/import
nodes.rationale: Single CSRF-protected, rate-limited, size-capped entry point returning per-entry saved/already_have/duplicate/rejected results.

nodes.label: Scan page
nodes.rationale: /scouting/scan on the lead's laptop: webcam view with progress, POSTs decoded entries to /scouting/import and shows per-entry results.

nodes.label: Scouter attribution rule
nodes.rationale: scouter_id must be the uploader or a teammate, else rejected; credit stays with scouter_id and uploaded_by records the uploader. Teammates can already edit each other's entries.

nodes.label: Stub users
nodes.rationale: Public-field-only users created from the file's users or a QR scout object (same team only) so pages show scout names, the team check passes and UNWIND_SCOUTER doesn't hide records; they cannot log in. Never created on the main server.

nodes.norm_label: task 2: export scope and venue cli commands
nodes.rationale: Stub users have no password_hash, so check_password returns False and login fails cleanly; CLI commands refuse unless VENUE_MODE=1 because they delete data.

nodes.norm_label: task 4: lead's pages work without the internet

nodes.label: Match13 fuel estimates

nodes.rationale: Venue-only: entries with an existing _id are stored with their known fields (excluded, keys, client_id, fuel) instead of rebuilt, so the laptop's stats match the main server's.

nodes.rationale: Builder-check call: each event starts from a fresh laptop DB so records deleted on castlescouting.com don't come back; refuses while unpushed origin venue records exist unless --force.

nodes.rationale: Match13 needs internet, so laptop-created zero-fuel entries are flagged and left out of fuel averages; otherwise $avg over $ifNull[...,0] would count them as 0.

nodes.rationale: Records created on the laptop get origin: venue so only they are pushed back, and main-server deletions are never undone.

nodes.rationale: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and WebRTC transfer excluded because FIRST event rules are believed to ban team-run Wi-Fi at venues (unconfirmed).

nodes.label: Same-team duplicate block
nodes.rationale: User chose block over replace (Maneuver's behaviour, silently loses the first entry) and over keep-both; server check rather than bypassable client check or a unique index that can't express 'same scouting team'. Known check-then-insert race accepted.

nodes.label: Outbox
nodes.rationale: On network failure entries queue in localStorage castle:outbox:<user> with client_id, scouter_id and created_at; if storage fails the draft is kept. Never lose the entry.

nodes.label: CQ1 frame format
nodes.rationale: One ASCII line per frame: CQ1|payloadId(FNV-1a)|K|byteLength|blockId|indices|base64; systematic first K blocks, later blocks XOR 2+ distinct chunks via robust soliton; 180-byte chunks keep frames ~300 chars at EC level L, 6 fps.

nodes.label: Decoder peeling
nodes.rationale: Builder-check fix: new frames are reduced by already-decoded chunks so decoding finishes in a reasonable number of frames.

nodes.label: QR payload id
nodes.rationale: Builder-check fix: each frame carries a payload id and the decoder resets when it changes, so two scouts' codes never mix.

nodes.label: QR transfer
nodes.rationale: Animated fountain-code QR lets scouts hand entries to the lead's laptop without any network; frames can be caught in any order and missed ones don't matter.

nodes.label: qrf fountain codec
nodes.rationale: Luby Transform with robust soliton distribution, reused from the qrf branch's qrf.js, but not its routes or list-page code.

nodes.label: Show QR panel
nodes.rationale: A panel on the add page so it works offline with no extra cached page; sending by QR does not remove entries from the outbox, which still syncs itself.

nodes.label: Vendored QR libraries
nodes.rationale: qrcodejs 1.0.0 for drawing and jsQR 1.4.0 for scanning are vendored so they work offline; BarcodeDetector used when available.

nodes.norm_label: selected paths list (max 6, 3 teams per alliance)
nodes.rationale: Up to 6 autonomous paths can be overlaid, at most 3 teams per alliance, mirroring a real match; the list is drag-reorderable (Sortable.js).

nodes.label: Match entry edit/delete permissions
nodes.rationale: Owner can edit and delete; teammates can edit; only a team admin can delete a teammate's entry; others get No access. Delete is a CSRF-protected POST with a confirm dialog.

nodes.label: Task 1: Year-agnostic TBA match key helper
nodes.norm_label: task 1: year-agnostic tba match key helper

nodes.label: Pit data table (CSV export hooks)
nodes.rationale: Column order and the .text-lg / .rounded-full / .text-sm.text-gray-500 class hooks are read by pit-scouting/list.js for CSV export, so they must be kept.

nodes.label: Contributing Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Asks for non-duplicate issues with complete tracebacks so bugs are workable, and PRs focused on a single aspect to reduce maintainer workload.

nodes.label: Git Commit Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Present-tense messages; reference issues as #123 outside the first line; prefix commands-extension commits with [commands]; unmet guidelines may be fixed on rebase.

nodes.label: displayTeamStatus()
nodes.rationale: Computes the win-loss-tie record client-side from previous match scores and renders ranking, previous and upcoming matches with HTML escaping.

nodes.label: live-match-status.html (Live team schedule page)
nodes.rationale: Shows a team's ranking and matches at its current event; upcoming match times are The Blue Alliance predictions.

nodes.label: Bandit Code Security Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs Bandit on app/ for every push and PR on Python 3.9 and uploads SARIF results to GitHub code scanning.

nodes.label: Sourcery Configuration
nodes.rationale: Default refactoring/suggestion/comment rules, minimum Python 3.9, ignores env and editor directories.

nodes.label: Bandit Configuration
nodes.rationale: Excludes venv and .github; overrides which os/subprocess/popen functions count as shell or no-shell calls.

nodes.label: Page contract: 500.html
nodes.rationale: Keep dependency-free: anything added to base.html must not raise when rendered from an error handler (possibly with MongoDB down).

nodes.label: Page contract: team/view.html
nodes.rationale: No JS hooks; keep url_for targets and anonymous rendering.
